claims.gist: Both consolidation and unbundling camps are right, describing different market layers
Large vendors have bought their way to complete CNAPP platforms through acquisitions
Buyers push consolidation because budgets are tight and consoles disagree
Toxic risk combinations are visible only when posture, workload, identity and data share one graph
Many buyers run CNAPP mainly as CSPM plus scanner while buying specialist tools
Specialists justify separate spend where depth decides outcomes, not bundled good-enough features
Buy the platform for its shared context graph, not its feature list

thesis: CNAPP consolidates at the platform layer but unbundles at the capability layer; buyers must know which layer they buy.
